CREATE TABLE `t_tenant_runtime_store` (
  `app_key` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `store_kind` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `key_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload` json NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` timestamp(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `updated_at` timestamp(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`app_key`,`store_kind`,`key_hash`),
  KEY `idx_tenant_store_expiry` (`is_active`,`expires_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `t_tenant_ticket_owner` (
  `ticket_id` varchar(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `program_id` int NOT NULL,
  `company_id` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`ticket_id`),
  KEY `idx_tenant_ticket_scope` (`program_id`,`company_id`,`ticket_id`),
  KEY `fk_tenant_ticket_company` (`company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_ticket_company` FOREIGN KEY (`company_id`) REFERENCES `m_company` (`company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_ticket_program` FOREIGN KEY (`program_id`) REFERENCES `m_company_program_list` (`program_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_ticket_ticket` FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `t_ticket` (`ticket_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_tenant_ticket_company` CHECK ((`company_id` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
